name: todo-app
description: React + NestJS + PostgreSQL to-do app. Run `npm run front` and `npm run back`.

scripts.front: cd Todoapp_Front && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm run dev
scripts.back: cd Todoapp_Back && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm run db:up && npm run start:dev
scripts.test: cd Todoapp_Back && npm run db:up && npm run test:e2e
